Sam: 02:10 deploy -> noticed apiserver leader flapping in us-west-2 concurrent with GPU node onboarding. some controller-manager loops backlog.
Vik: any kernel errors?
Sam: kernel logs show nf_conntrack overflow and `xtables` errors. example:
```
nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
iptables-restore: error on line 123: chain not found
```
Lea: I'm pausing the autoscaler. can we restart kube-proxy on the top 4 affected nodes?
Vik: doing soft restart now. conntrack counts dropping. apiserver watch reconnects dropping too.
ops-bot: alert cleared: apiserver.watch.latency back to normal (1729993333)
Sam: logging INFRA-2060: "awsv2-gpu-onboard-conntrack-mitigation"
Vik: follow-ups: add autoscaler circuit-breaker for conntrack > 75%, increase sysctl nf_conntrack_max on gpu pool images where safe, and add staggered image pull strategy for bulk onboards.
Lea: adding runbook step for checking cloud NAT SNAT exhausted counters before large onboards.
Sam: resolved, will link logs and packet captures.
